All ground-truth assertions match: real_users=2 with exact emails {pgirwalkar@gmail.com, ar.priyankasg@gmail.com}, and total_users=346 (became 347 after I registered one fresh @test.com harness user, which correctly stayed excluded).
critical_code_review_comments: _REAL_USER_QUERY regex uses `^(test|uitest|sam3|sprint|region_pref|other|empty|qa)[_0-9]` which REQUIRES an underscore/digit AFTER the prefix. Therefore future accounts like `qatester@gmail.com`, `sprints@gmail.com`, `otherman@gmail.com` will NOT be filtered even though the spec says any local-part *starting with* qa/sprint/other should be excluded. Not currently a bug (no such rows in DB), but a latent correctness gap — consider `^(test|uitest|sam3|region_pref|empty)_|^(sprint|other|qa|sam3)` or split into two clauses.

AdminReviews toggle uses row index `i` for data-testid — after reordering (e.g., new submission) indices shift; acceptable for admin-only view but note for future automated tests keying by review id would be more stable.
LeaveReview submit success does not `navigate` away; it shows the thank-you panel in-place. Acceptable and matches spec (review-submitted data-testid asserted).
